Use case: stylized-concept. NEW KFB weird surreal worker-family illustration. Exactly SIX complete UNIQUE ink blob cartoon claymation monsters, landscape1536x1024 transparent PNG sheet3columns by2rows. STYLE reference1: original veteran ONLY rounded ink body and plasticine material. STYLE reference2: original RPG sheet ONLY rich hand-sculpted accessory craft, not repeated faces, red eyeballs or source identities. Start six new characters, not edits of previous generated sheets. Thick continuous charcoal-black ink bodies with subtle dark violet sheen, rounded asymmetric splat lobes and a few round ink droplets, short goo hands. Huge expressive faces directly in body. Whole upright FOOTLESS blobs, no human torso, no legs, feet or cropped busts. Rich soft modeled plasticine with fine fingerprints and thick handmade fabric, leather, wood, metal; never angular stone, coarse patchy camouflage or glossy generic Pixar human. Exactly TWO female-read subtly via lashes/headwrap/lids, no human anatomy. WHITE/IVORY EYEBALLS, RED IRIS, BLACK PUPIL. Eyes exposed, goggles only above eyes; clay eyelids fully violet, not ivory. Lip color normally same purple-black as body, not random rosy human lips. Teeth originate INSIDE mouth only; upper teeth descend from roof/gum above lower lip, no teeth on exterior lips, closed mouths toothless. Vary mouth/acting genuinely. Props few bold and FUNCTIONAL: simple correct handle/tool connections, clear wrists/grips, not complicated nonsense machinery. Emotions absurd and relatable, maximum readable acting at decisive moment. Costume is small patches/panels around body, never a full humanoid outfit. No signage text or generic gag labels.
FAMILY: Feuerwehr – Wache Nachlöschen. COSTUME: mixed timeless retro/contemporary fire brigade: warm brass/red helmets, dark navy cloth with small yellow trim; no human full suits.
TOP LEFT — Brandmeisterin Löschschluss, weiblich-read. tall top-heavy ink pear, red firefighter helmet with little brass crest, two subtle lashes, one goo hand holding compact speaking trumpet at flank and other planted on goo hip; broad lifted brow, gritted internal two upper teeth, exhausted determination. Personality: Can organize an emergency faster than she can admit she needs a rest.
TOP MIDDLE — Schlauchwart Knickfrei, maennlich-read. broad flat-bottom rounded splat, brass retro fire helmet, short coiled red hose with brass nozzle clearly connected; wide uneven eyes following nozzle down, tiny toothless worried triangular open mouth. Personality: Trusts water completely and hoses only provisionally.
TOP RIGHT — Axtträger Offenjetzt, maennlich-read. lean curved hook-shaped blob, small dark leather fire helmet, single short chunky fire axe held vertical beside body; one hooded eye one raised brow, closed sideways toothless sneer. Personality: Regards every locked door as a discussion that has gone on too long.
BOTTOM LEFT — Maschinist Drucksache, maennlich-read. round drooping blob in navy cap, tiny yellow collar tabs, compact pump-pressure gauge connected to ONE short shutoff valve; huge ivory eyes looking inward at dial, open oval mouth with one upper tooth. Personality: Can hold the pressure steady while everything else becomes approximate.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — Rettungsmann Ganzruhig, maennlich-read. square-ish broad splat, plain yellow fire helmet, one compact rescue rope loop held at side; eyes bright and determined, broad crooked toothy smile with two upper teeth, no external tongue. Personality: Lends his calm to anyone who has temporarily misplaced theirs.
BOTTOM RIGHT — Funkerin Nachalarm, weiblich-read. low lopsided asymmetrical blob, small red fire helmet with goggles parked high, two subtle lashes, chunky handheld radio and short dark scarf; droopy skeptical lids, closed toothless zigzag mouth. Personality: Hears the next emergency in the silence after the last one.
COMPOSITION: Equal substantial full-body visual scale, three columns/two rows, each complete character within its own roughly460x440pixel area. Similar figure heights across rows, no shrinking bottom row. At least32px clear transparent inter-row/column gutters and generous outer margin. Separate silhouettes/props/droplets, no overlaps or cropped objects. Camera-facing character posing with slight twist. No background color, scenery, factory/building/fire/waterground, ground plane, shadow discs, labels, letters, numbers, watermark, borders or gridlines. Genuine transparent alpha.
